findings.explanation: With `tmsig = FEMPTY`, Lean proves `instance_ FEMPTY i name ty τ = tmaof i name []` for every valuation `τ`. HOL4 specifies the result only when lookup succeeds and a substitution produces `ty` from the declared type. An empty signature makes that premise false for every witness, leaving the result unconstrained.
findings.repair:
axiom instance_ (tmsig : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) : tyval U → U

axiom instance_spec (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty ty0 : type) (tyin : List (type × type)) (hlookup : FLOOKUP s name = some ty0) (hsubst : ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0) :
  instance_ s i name ty = fun τ => tmaof i name (MAP (typesem (tyaof i) τ ∘ TYPE_SUBST tyin ∘ Tyvar) (MAP .implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0)))))
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics
open HOL Candle.Mlstring Candle.HolSyntax Candle.HolSemantics

example {U : Type} (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) (τ : tyval U) :
    instance_ FEMPTY i name ty τ = tmaof i name [] := by
  simp [instance_, FLOOKUP, FEMPTY]

findings.explanation: For `U = Nat`, Lean proves that `Abs (Const name ty) b` denotes `0` for every interpretation and valuation. The catch-all branch returns `HOL.ARB`, which unfolds to the `Nat` default. HOL4 saves an abstraction equation only for `Abs (Var x ty) b`. Its equations leave the value on a constant binder open.
findings.repair:
private opaque unspecifiedAbs [Inhabited U] (mem : U → U → Prop) (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (v : valuation U) (binder body : term) : U := ARB

def termsem [Inhabited U] (mem : U → U → Prop) (tmsig : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) : valuation U → term → U
  | v, .Var x ty => tmvof v (x, ty)
  | v, .Const name ty => instance_ tmsig i name ty (tyvof v)
  | v, .Comb t1 t2 => apply mem (termsem mem tmsig i v t1) (termsem mem tmsig i v t2)
  | v, .Abs (.Var x ty) b =>
    abstract mem (typesem (tyaof i) (tyvof v) ty) (typesem (tyaof i) (tyvof v) (typeof b))
      (fun m => termsem mem tmsig i (tyvof v, (UPDATE (x, ty) m) (tmvof v)) b)
  | v, .Abs binder b => unspecifiedAbs mem tmsig i v binder b
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics
open Candle.Mlstring Candle.HolSyntax Candle.HolSemantics

example (mem : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation Nat) (v : valuation Nat) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) (b : term) :
    termsem mem s i v (.Abs (.Const name ty) b) = 0 := by
  simp [termsem, HOL.ARB]
